meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会查看、添加或删除 NanoClaw agent 容器可访问的主机目录白名单（文件在 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json），并为每个目录标明只读还是读写。
howto.when: 当你说出「mounts」「mount allowlist」等关键词，或要求查看、增加、删除 agent 容器可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 看看当前的 mount allowlist 配置
say.note: 会列出允许的目录及各自只读或读写

say.text: 把 /data 加进允许目录，设为只读
say.note: 先校验路径存在，再写入配置

say.text: 从 mount allowlist 里删掉 /tmp
say.note: 更新配置文件，新起的容器自动生效

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can view, add, or remove entries in the NanoClaw mount allowlist (~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json), marking each host directory read-only or read-write for agent containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", etc., or ask to view, add, or remove directories that agent containers can access.

say_en.text: Show me the current mount allowlist
say_en.note: Lists allowed directories and each one's read/write mode

say_en.text: Add /data to the allowed directories as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path first, then writes the config
Updates the config; new containers pick it up
